keywords: The Petitioners sought to challenge the Development Permit issued by the 1st Respondent to the 7th Respondent, who is the owner of the land in suit and developer, on the basis that the said permit is violative of the regulations promulgated under the Urban Development Authority Law; Preliminary objection that the permit had already lapsed and continued interim stay order had halted constructions, therefore, application was merely academic. Held – Application dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
